verdict.rationale: The evidence shows uv has a cross-platform lockfile (uv.lock) and commands that update it (uv add, uv lock --upgrade-package). Nothing in the pack documents a frozen or locked install mode that fails when pyproject.toml and uv.lock disagree. Lockfile existence and update behavior are adjacent features, not the enforcement capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce a frozen/immutable lockfile mode that fails the install when the manifest and lockfile disagree
